messages:
Maya (CS): Quick sweep of Lighthouse Retail onboarding calls — noticing recurring asks: 1) per-route cost breakdowns, 2) embedding freshness controls, 3) canned fallback messaging for model downtimes. Starting a thread to capture raw asks for triage on Monday. :eyes:

Jon (CSM): thanks — dropping my raw notes below.

Jon (CSM): [raw notes]
- customer asks more granular 'route' billing by feature (search vs summarization)
- wants ability to set embedding refresh cadence per-customer
- requested cheaper fallback model option auto-switch

Priya (Product): can you include severity (production blocker / nice-to-have) and flow impact? helps prioritization.

Jon (CSM): severity tags added inline.

Jon (CSM): 
- per-route billing -> Severity: high; Blocks GA rollout for billing admin
- embedding refresh cadence -> Severity: medium; UX friction for stale search
- fallback model auto-switch -> Severity: high; renewal risk if not resilient

Sam (PM): @Priya @Maya can we get short examples of ownership? e.g., UI change vs backend pipeline?

Maya (CS): quick mapping:
- per-route billing -> backend + billing UI (Finance + Platform)
- embedding refresh cadence -> backend + scheduler (ML infra)
- fallback model auto-switch -> routing policy + runtime (Eng runtime)

Noah (AE): flagging renewal risk for Lighthouse — they'll push renewal if resilience not solved. I can buy us time if we have a mitigation plan by Wed.

Priya (Product): Thanks. My ask: each owner add a 1-line mitigation and ETA by EOD tomorrow. I'll draft initial priority score: per-route billing (P2), fallback auto-switch (P1), embedding refresh cadence (P3).

Maya (CS): I can surface customer quotes in Confluence. Quick snippet: "We need to see cost per feature to justify expansion" — quoting their CFO.

Jon (CSM): also: asked for a toggle to temporarily disable embeddings for cheap routes (workaround).

Sam (PM): good workaround — add as a short-term action item.

ops-bot: survey-form: new feedback form submitted by Lighthouse Retail (3 items). Link: https://redwood.co/cs/forms/5189990000

Maya (CS): ok team—I'll collect the remaining raw bits from recorded calls and put in the triage doc under /cs/triage/5189990000 — @Sam @Priya please add owners/ETAs there.

Priya (Product): will do. also, can Sales confirm renewal date? @Noah

Noah (AE): renewal is 2026-05-10. pushing for mitigation update in next customer sync.

Maya (CS): great. If anyone has more snippets, paste here. If not, I'll close the thread after EOD tomorrow once triage doc has owners.

Priya (Product): :thumbsup:

Maya (CS): Thanks everyone.
